svg.title: What keeps working when Wi-Fi drops
svg.desc: A timeline from Wi-Fi dropping to its return. Scheduled meals keep running from the running clock until its error passes 2 minutes, any time up to about 6.6 hours after the drop, then hold. The Dispense button keeps working on an unlocked panel throughout, though it can refuse a press while the feeder rejoins. The app and the CLI can't reach the feeder throughout. When time returns, a meal under 15 minutes late runs and an older one is skipped.
svg.text: feeds on an unlocked panel, but can refuse a press while rejoining
The 2 minutes can pass any time up to about 6.6 hours after the drop.
When time returns, a meal under 15 minutes late runs, and an older one is skipped.
